paragraphs: Act as a financial-statement analyst. Find the most recent annual report/10-K for [TESLA] for the fiscal year ended [2025] using the company investor-relations site or SEC EDGAR. Do not rely on press releases, blogs, or secondary summaries where the annual report is available. Report the document title, fiscal year-end, filing date, source URL, and the financial-statement currency/units.
Analyse how assets are financed (debt, equity and internal financing) only based on the information in balance sheet.
